bounded_statement: The selected result claims an occurrence rate for the entire 96-station scheduled network but divides the 18 observed occurrences by only the 72 stations retained after screening.

counterevidence_considered.description: The numerator is explicitly described as occurrences observed among retained stations; this would support an 18/72 rate if the target were conditional on retention, but it does not change the task or selected claim from the entire scheduled network to that subset.

source_refs.quoted_text: Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

counterevidence_considered.description: Omitted scheduled records visibly have NA occurrence flags, which could motivate reporting a retained-subset descriptive rate, but the selected report does not label its claim as conditional on retention.

evidence.description: The stated task requires one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a compact coastal-station workflow that reports one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The report defines the target population as all 96 scheduled stations and accounts for 72 retained plus 24 omitted stations.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: all 96 scheduled coastal stations in the survey network.

Scheduled stations (planned units): 96
Stations passing the signal screen: 72
Stations omitted by the signal screen: 24

evidence.description: The selected result expressly claims the entire scheduled network while using the 72 retained stations as its exposure denominator.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Exposure denominator: the 72 stations retained after the signal screen.
[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: 18 occurrences divided by 72 retained stations = 0.25 (25.00 occurrences per 100 stations).

evidence.description: The generating workflow directly interpolates SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS into both the denominator statement and the selected complete-network claim.

source_refs.quoted_text:
DENOMINATOR_LINE = f'Exposure denominator: the {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} stations retained after the signal screen.' + LF
SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} retained stations = {SELECTED_RATE_FRACTION} ({SELECTED_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 stations).' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the issue by determining whether 18/72 was explicitly a rate conditional on screen retention. The retained-only numerator at results/report.md line 11 and retained denominator at line 14 could form such a conditional statistic, but task.md line 1, results/report.md line 4, and the selected claim at line 15 all specify the entire scheduled network. The workflow source at lines 22-23 confirms that the retained-subset constant is nevertheless used, so the mismatch remains demonstrated.

root_cause: The workflow constructs the selected denominator from SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS rather than SCHEDULED_STATIONS, even though its target and selected-result wording refer to the complete scheduled network.
